media.title: Richard Thorpe on the set of Cheating Cheaters, 1934
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the film director Richard Thorpe on a film set in 1934.
media.publicCaption: Richard Thorpe photographed on the set of Cheating Cheaters (Universal, 1934), cropped from a publicity still. Thorpe directed Last of the Pagans (1935) and The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn (1939), both documented here.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer, Universal Pictures, via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States: the Wikimedia Commons file page records the still as published in the United States between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice. The Commons template notes that the work may remain protected in jurisdictions that do not apply the rule of the shorter term to United States works. The image here is a crop from the larger publicity still Cheating Cheaters (1934) set 1.jpg.
